title: Fixed Crosshead Crank and Flywheel Bench
description: One newly authored complete static steam-workshop drive-bench display: a grounded continuous base supports an open-top horizontal cylinder with visible separate piston, real bored front gland and a rod reaching a crosshead block between two full guides. One complete inclined two-eye connecting rod is retained on the crosshead pin and an actual offset crank pin. A separate crank disk, full shaft, two bored bearing pedestals and one full open-spoke flywheel complete the new assembly. All geometry is freshly authored, not a scene containing old cylinder/rod/gear props, not a resized cutaway cylinder or extra copied gear. The flywheel has a complete annular rim and six whole radial spokes around a hub, with real open spaces. Metres, native Z up, horizontal-bounds-centred grounded origin, three opaque solid untextured PBR materials and individually editable closed components. One complete prop, zero scene. One fixed illustrative pose only: no steam, pressure, cycle timing, torque, power, force transmission, working bearing fit, travel envelope, full-stroke collision clearance, rigging, animation, efficiency, load, stability, manufacture or safety claim.
